titulo: One small kind thing (World Kindness Day)
alt: A short film for Stories, no voice. A warm yellow kitchen with a table and one plate. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes walks up, leans in, and a second plate with a slice of cake appears beside the first. It pulses with happy eyes. The sentence stays on screen: if this finds you, do one small kind thing today.
